hold_cover_help_p1: - Base Path: atlas base path (default holdCover/holdCover), reads holdCover{Color}{Skin}.png
hold_cover_help_p2: Frame prefix: holdCoverStart{Color} (head) / holdCover{Color} (loop) / holdCoverEnd{Color} (tail burst)
hold_cover_help_p3: - Color: select the color to edit (Purple/Blue/Green/Red) and set its three animation prefixes
hold_cover_help_p4: - Scale: overall scaling (default glow is about 1.9x width of the arrow)
hold_cover_help_p5: - Offsets: enable Use Arrow Keys, then arrow keys fine-tune the offset of the current color
hold_cover_help_p7: - Template: exports a template JSON for reference
hold_cover_help_p8: In-game, Hold Cover Skin can be selected in Visuals settings (requires images/holdCover/list.txt).
hold_cover_help_close: Press ESC or click anywhere to close.
